title.orig: This is my letter to the world
title.en: This is my letter to the world

edition.en: Poems by Emily Dickinson (1890), edited by Mabel Loomis Todd and T. W. Higginson, on Project Gutenberg (eBook 12242)
edition.zh: 据古登堡计划电子书 12242 所录《艾米莉·狄金森诗集》（1890），托德与希金森编

basis.en: First published in 1890, after the author’s death in 1886; the editors died in 1911 and 1932.
basis.zh: 1890 年首次出版，作者已于 1886 年去世；两位编者分别卒于 1911 年和 1932 年。

note.en: Dickinson’s editors placed this poem at the front of the first selection of her work, four years after her death, as a kind of preface. It is a letter sent with no expectation of a reply, entrusted “to hands I cannot see”. Every reader of it now is one of those hands.
note.zh: 狄金森去世四年后，编者把这首诗放在她第一部诗选的最前面，当作一篇序言。这是一封不指望回信的信，托付给“我看不见的手”。今天读到它的每一个人，都是那些手中的一双。

excerpt.orig:
Her message is committed
To hands I cannot see;
excerpt.en:
Her message is committed
To hands I cannot see;
excerpt.zh:
她的讯息已经托付
给我看不见的手；
